scheme_name: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana
description:
The Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to women engaged in domestic work and pregnant women in the unorganized sector. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to support women workers who often lack social security and financial stability. 

The scheme specifically targets women who are engaged in domestic work and those who are pregnant or recently delivered. 

The government has set a measurable target of providing assistance to at least 1 million women under this scheme in its first year of implementation. 

The benefits of this scheme include a direct cash transfer of ₹6,000. 

This amount is provided in two installments of ₹3,000 each. 

The first installment is disbursed during the pregnancy period. 

The second installment is provided after the delivery of the child. 

This financial support is crucial for women who may not have access to maternity benefits or paid leave. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and detailed. 

Women must be aged between 18 and 45 years to qualify for the benefits. 

They must also be engaged in domestic work or be pregnant women from the unorganized sector. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹10,000 per month. 

This ensures that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need. 

To apply for the scheme, applicants must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

Applicants need to fill out an online application form. 

The form requires personal details such as name, age, address, and income details. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of their engagement in domestic work or a medical certificate confirming pregnancy. 

Required documents include an Aadhar card for identity verification. 

Proof of income such as salary slips or bank statements may also be needed. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for application processing is approximately 30 days. 

After approval, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The disbursement is typically done within 15 days of approval. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The specific department responsible for overseeing the implementation is the Directorate General of Labour Welfare. 

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official website of the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the welfare of women workers in India. 

It recognizes the significant contribution of women in the informal sector. 

Statistics indicate that over 90% of women workers in India are employed in the unorganized sector. 

This sector often lacks adequate social security measures. 

The Theka Shramik scheme aims to bridge this gap by providing essential financial support. 

Moreover, the scheme aligns with the government’s commitment to empower women economically. 

It also contributes to the overall goal of improving maternal health in the country. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is expected to reduce the economic burden on women during pregnancy. 

It also aims to promote better health outcomes for mothers and infants. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the implementation process. 

The government plans to expand the reach of the scheme in subsequent years. 

This includes increasing the budget allocation to accommodate more beneficiaries. 

In the first year, the government allocated ₹600 crore for the implementation of this scheme. 

This funding is aimed at ensuring that the financial assistance reaches the intended recipients without delays. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of awareness among potential beneficiaries. 

Awareness campaigns are being conducted to inform women about the scheme and its benefits. 

Local NGOs and community organizations are being engaged to facilitate outreach. 

The government encourages beneficiaries to share their experiences to promote transparency. 

The Theka Shramik scheme is a step towards recognizing the rights of women workers. 

It aims to provide them with a safety net during critical periods of their lives. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of social security measures being implemented by the government. 

It aligns with various other initiatives aimed at women’s empowerment and welfare. 

Overall, the Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana is a crucial initiative. 

It addresses the unique challenges faced by women in the unorganized sector. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the lives of many women across India. 

By providing financial support during pregnancy, it aims to enhance the quality of life for both mothers and children. 

The government remains committed to monitoring and improving the scheme for better outcomes. 

This initiative reflects the ongoing efforts to promote gender equality and social justice in India. 

The Theka Shramik scheme is a vital component of the government’s welfare strategy. 

It underscores the importance of supporting vulnerable populations in society. 

As the scheme progresses, it will be essential to track its effectiveness and reach. 

The government aims to ensure that no eligible woman is left behind in accessing these benefits. 

Through this scheme, the Indian government is taking significant steps towards empowering women and improving their socio-economic conditions.
